caption: I saw this video from @katstickler about quiet time after school, and I loved it so much. I'm sure a lot of you will relate too, that pull to jump in with a hundred questions the second your kid gets in the car. If you're wondering why "how was your day?" so often gets a "fine" it's because your kid hasn't switched from school mode to home mode yet. School mode is armor. All day, they're reading the room, managing their face, figuring out where they stand, that takes real effort we don't always credit them for. Home mode is where the armor comes off. And that switch doesn't flip the second they leave the building. It flips when their body decides it's safe enough to let go of the day. So next time you get a "fine," maybe just let it be fine for a minute. The rest tends to show up on its own. 💛
